tickets.title: Coordinate charitable transfer
tickets.text: Evaluate Nadia Willowdoodle's concentrated Copper Firefly Energy shares in her Velvet Acorn Custody joint taxable account to determine suitability for her planned $18,000 gift to the Moonbadger Literacy Foundation, considering holiday travel constraints.

subTasks.title: Confirm gift intent and transfer method
subTasks.text: Document the charitable purpose ($18,000 to Moonbadger Literacy Foundation), asset description (Copper Firefly Energy shares in Velvet Acorn Custody), and preferred timing (before holiday travel).

subTasks.title: Review tax and planning considerations
subTasks.text: Check alignment with the financial plan, charitable deduction strategy, and cost basis considerations for the Copper Firefly Energy shares.

subTasks.title: Prepare transfer instructions and approvals
subTasks.text: Gather custodian forms for Velvet Acorn Custody and delivery instructions for the Moonbadger Literacy Foundation.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion and records
subTasks.text: Verify delivery and update the planning record with final transfer details.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by November 15, 2023 to evaluate appreciated shares for Nadia’s planned $18,000 Moonbadger Literacy Foundation gift before holiday travel.

tickets.title: Obtain restricted stock vesting confirmation

tickets.evidence: By October 20, 2023, the latest restricted stock vesting confirmation or payroll withholding detail from Cloudberry Kite Robotics is needed to estimate 2023 tax exposure.

tickets.title: Review cash, bonus, and mortgage for college savings
tickets.text: Review the household's cash above the six-month reserve target, the expected $58,000 December bonus, and the $417,000 mortgage principal to compare options for college savings and taxable investments.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by December 8, 2023 to review cash above the stated six-month reserve target and the expected bonus for college savings, taxable investment, and mortgage principal comparisons.
